thread:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for release v2026.03.1 starting in 5m to prod-east. Canary: 5%.
oncall-erin: there's an incident page up for prod-east: https://incidents/internal/INC-4721 :warning:
maria: linking — impact is request error spike and DB throttling observed. devs are investigating.
jamie: thanks. can we pause the deploy until incident triage completes? don't want to add pressure.
alex: +1. if we proceed we might hit the same DB migration path. hold please.
deploy-bot: Hold applied to release v2026.03.1 by @oncall-erin. Deploy stopped. ETA unknown.
sre_lead: quick checks: is this caused by new read path? anything that would be affected by this release?
maria: early signal points to backlog on async workers, not the deploy code paths, but noisy.
jamie: still, safer to reschedule. propose slide to maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC.
product_ops: if we move, need note for customers + update release notes. also any pinned versions for rollbacks?
alex: current canary uses image tag redwood/api:v2.3.1. We should pin that in case we need a rollback to v2.3.0.
oncall-erin: agree. I'll pin traffic to v2.3.0 in routing for prod-east now. Command: `traffic-route set --env prod-east --tag v2.3.0`.
jamie: confirm runbook step: abort canary and mark release as 'on-hold' in release-board. I'll do the release-board update.
deploy-bot: Canary aborted for v2026.03.1. Release status updated to ON-HOLD by jamie.
maria: ops update: engineers are throttling back ingestion and running a controlled worker restart, monitoring.
product_ops: reschedule proposal accepted. New deploy window 2026-04-12 02:00 UTC. Who owns rollback plan?
sre_lead: I'll own rollback runbook. Will add checklist: preflight queries, DB index checks, and spike mitigation toggles.
alex: please include the exact pin and unpin commands in runbook and a quick smoke test script. I can add that.
oncall-erin: noted. I'll keep channel open and post incident follow-ups. For now labels: incident -> hold-release -> reschedule.
maria: team will post a short customer update once we have the postmortem summary.
jamie: thanks everyone. tagging @deploy-bot for final state. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: Release v2026.03.1 is ON-HOLD. Next tentative deploy window: 2026-04-12T02:00Z. Thread closed.
